status: FIT-ONLY DESCRIPTIVE DIAGNOSTIC (protocol Addendum B2). Not a model-selection criterion; changes no score, threshold, configuration or decision rule.

definitions.native_mask: align.foreground_mask (colour heuristic incl. Addendum B1 hue exclusion), 1/4 scale
definitions.iou_vs_p0: IoU of the condition's native mask with the same image's P0 mask, same variant
definitions.warp_discrepancy_px: RMS distance (native px) over the 1152x768 crop between the sampling positions of the condition's registration and the same image's P0 registration (same variant). The P0 registration is a heuristic reference.
definitions.template_residual_shift_px: phase-correlation translation (native px, 1/4-scale grey, full frame) between the registered image and the variant's FIT template (heuristic reference = mean of registered FIT images)
definitions.roi_coverage: fraction of the image's model-frame board mask inside the fixed ROI (the fail-safe statistic; fallback iff < coverage_min = 0.95)
definitions.roi_outside_mask_frac: fraction of fixed-ROI pixels outside the image's own model-frame board mask (colour heuristic: misses pins, LED leads, dark parts)
definitions.roi_cloth_frac: fraction of fixed-ROI pixels classified as green cloth (S > 90 and hue in the Addendum B1 band) in the registered model frame (heuristic)
definitions.gain/offset: candidate correction I' = gain * I + offset computed from the image it receives
definitions.clip: fraction of RGB channel values equal to 0 or 255 after perturbation (and correction)
definitions.board_local_contrast: mean Sobel gradient magnitude of the grey image inside the board region

background_dominance.note: board region = baseline P0 colour mask of the raw image (heuristic); background region = cloth-hue pixels > ~24 px from that mask (heuristic). Not ground truth.
